svg.title: Same operation, different information
svg.desc: Blue and orange hands in a MuJoCo scene accompany a matrix of S-only, S+C, S+T, C+T and S+C+T views. Shared parent splits and valid labels feed separate S1 supervision and S0 feedback training.
svg.text: Split by parent before making views.
Use a view only if its labels are valid.
Keep all S / C / T prediction heads.
Apply dropout as a separate choice.
Static MuJoCo scene; no new rollout.
